purpose: Complete the already authorized computational experiment batch after all prescribed fits, using a fixed test protocol
proceed_rule: Proceed after every planned fit, calibration, data/source/checkpoint audit and evaluator check passes. Development effect size or direction is not an acceptance condition.
model_selection: Use all prescribed models at their fixed final epochs; no best model is selected for reporting
hypotheses: Retain supportive, null and contrary results, including raw versus calibrated confidence and both false-negative and false-positive outcomes
development_observations_at_review: The initial raw confidence-omission ordering changed after development cross-event temperature calibration
The original sigmoid value router did not improve IoU over fusion in the first two nested development folds
In the Henan development fold, probability averaging improved IoU while increasing remaining missed area under the same entropy-based review budget and reducing false positives
exploratory_diagnostics: Analytic and ridge routing were studied after the first development fold; they are excluded from the main frozen core model comparisons
review_type: Assistant review of the fixed protocol followed by automatic completeness and integrity checks; no claim that pending numerical results were already manually reviewed
scope: Computational evaluation against released benchmark reference labels; submission readiness, independent label adjudication and real human-review performance are separate assessments
